cn.name: 可证伪性
cn.description: 经验性主张具有可证伪性，是指存在可能的观察结果会与它不相容；它是波普尔提出的科学划界准则之一。
trigger: 判断一个理论是否科学
avoid_when: 不可证伪不等于毫无价值；伦理与数学问题另有评价方式。
可证伪不意味着已被证实，也不是当前科学划界的唯一观点。
transform: 明确主张的对象和条件。
事先写出相冲突的观察。
设计检验并检查异常来源。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：明确主张的对象和条件。 事先写出相冲突的观察。 设计检验并检查异常来源。 不可证伪不等于毫无价值；伦理与数学问题另有评价方式。
cn.source_text: Stephen Thornton — Karl Popper, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/popper/
questions: 哪种观察与主张不相容？
异常可能来自测量或辅助假设吗？
examples: 说明性示例：把“知识库总能帮助思考”改成有边界的预测：在一组指定任务中，用户能否找到此前不知道且可解释相关性的概念。
cn.article_body:
经验性主张具有可证伪性，是指存在可能的观察结果会与它不相容；它是波普尔提出的科学划界准则之一。

一个允许任何结果的解释很难接受经验检验。实践应用可先写预测和失败条件，再开展观察。测量错误与辅助假设也可能造成异常，因此逻辑上的反例与实际推翻理论需要区分。

## 如何应用

1. 明确主张的对象和条件。
2. 事先写出相冲突的观察。
3. 设计检验并检查异常来源。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：把“知识库总能帮助思考”改成有边界的预测：在一组指定任务中，用户能否找到此前不知道且可解释相关性的概念。

## 使用边界

不可证伪不等于毫无价值；伦理与数学问题另有评价方式。

可证伪不意味着已被证实，也不是当前科学划界的唯一观点。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Stephen Thornton — Karl Popper, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/popper/)

en.name: Falsifiability
en.description: An empirical claim is falsifiable if a possible observation could conflict with it; Popper proposed this as a demarcation criterion for science.
trigger: Judging whether a theory is scientific
Evaluating the value of a hypothesis
avoid_when: Unfalsifiable does not mean valueless; ethics and mathematics use other standards.
Falsifiability is neither proof of truth nor the sole account of scientific demarcation.
transform: Specify the claim and its conditions.
State incompatible observations in advance.
Test and examine sources of anomalies.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Specify the claim and its conditions. State incompatible observations in advance. Test and examine sources of anomalies. Unfalsifiable does not mean valueless; ethics and mathematics use other standards.
en.source_text: Stephen Thornton — Karl Popper, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/popper/
questions: Which observation would conflict with the claim?
Could an anomaly arise from measurement or auxiliary assumptions?
examples: Illustrative example: Replace “the library always helps” with a bounded test of whether users find unfamiliar, relevant concepts for specified tasks.
en.article_body:
An empirical claim is falsifiable if a possible observation could conflict with it; Popper proposed this as a demarcation criterion for science.

An explanation compatible with every outcome is difficult to test. Specify predictions and failure conditions before observing. Measurement error and auxiliary assumptions can produce anomalies, so logical falsification and practical theory rejection must be distinguished.

## Applying the idea

1. Specify the claim and its conditions.
2. State incompatible observations in advance.
3. Test and examine sources of anomalies.

## An example

Illustrative example: Replace “the library always helps” with a bounded test of whether users find unfamiliar, relevant concepts for specified tasks.

## Limits

Unfalsifiable does not mean valueless; ethics and mathematics use other standards.

Falsifiability is neither proof of truth nor the sole account of scientific demarcation.

## Sources and further reading

- [Stephen Thornton — Karl Popper, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/popper/)

cn.name: 合成谬误
cn.description: 仅因某个性质对部分成员成立，就断言它必然对由这些成员组成的整体成立。
trigger: 从个体特征推断整体特征
论证中出现'每个人……所以整体……'
avoid_when: 有明确聚合规则时，从部分推整体可以有效。
指出推理缺陷不等于已经证明结论相反。
transform: 分别列出部分与整体层面的命题。
找出所依赖的聚合假设。
检查相互作用或反例后重新推断。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：分别列出部分与整体层面的命题。 找出所依赖的聚合假设。 检查相互作用或反例后重新推断。 有明确聚合规则时，从部分推整体可以有效。
cn.source_text: Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Composition, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy — https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Composition
questions: 性质是否能够按这里的方式加总？
部分之间有什么相互作用？
examples: 说明性示例：每个人利用率很高不保证团队交付快；需要继续检查等待、交接和同时开展的任务。
cn.article_body:
仅因某个性质对部分成员成立，就断言它必然对由这些成员组成的整体成立。

整体结果还可能取决于成员间的连接、等待和约束。识别谬误需要指出迁移缺少哪一步，而非笼统反对从部分了解整体。对可以加总的性质，部分数据仍可能正确支持整体结论。

## 如何应用

1. 分别列出部分与整体层面的命题。
2. 找出所依赖的聚合假设。
3. 检查相互作用或反例后重新推断。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：每个人利用率很高不保证团队交付快；需要继续检查等待、交接和同时开展的任务。

## 使用边界

有明确聚合规则时，从部分推整体可以有效。

指出推理缺陷不等于已经证明结论相反。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Composition, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Composition)

en.name: Fallacy of Composition
en.description: The fallacy of composition infers a property of a whole merely from that property being true of its parts.
trigger: Arguments of the form 'everyone... so the whole...'
avoid_when: Valid aggregation can justify the inference.
A defective argument does not prove the opposite conclusion.
transform: Separate part-level and whole-level claims.
State the aggregation assumption.
Test interactions and counterexamples.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Separate part-level and whole-level claims. State the aggregation assumption. Test interactions and counterexamples. Valid aggregation can justify the inference.
en.source_text: Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Composition, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy — https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Composition
questions: Is this property additive in the proposed way?
How do the parts interact?
examples: Illustrative example: High utilization for every worker does not establish fast team delivery; examine queues and handoffs.
en.article_body:
The fallacy of composition infers a property of a whole merely from that property being true of its parts.

Interactions, queues, and constraints can affect the aggregate. Identify the missing justification for transferring the property. Where valid aggregation rules apply, reasoning from parts can be sound.

## Applying the idea

1. Separate part-level and whole-level claims.
2. State the aggregation assumption.
3. Test interactions and counterexamples.

## An example

Illustrative example: High utilization for every worker does not establish fast team delivery; examine queues and handoffs.

## Limits

Valid aggregation can justify the inference.

A defective argument does not prove the opposite conclusion.

## Sources and further reading

- [Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Composition, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Composition)

cn.name: 分解谬误
cn.description: 仅因整体具有某种性质，就断言每个组成部分或成员也必然具有该性质。
trigger: 从整体属性推断个体属性
论证中出现'……很强，所以每个成员都强'
avoid_when: 定义上适用于全部成员的性质可以下推，不能机械贴标签。
整体信息仍可提供背景，但通常不足以保证个体结果。
transform: 标出整体命题与个体结论。
检查分布及指标定义。
补充具体对象证据再作判断。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：标出整体命题与个体结论。 检查分布及指标定义。 补充具体对象证据再作判断。 定义上适用于全部成员的性质可以下推，不能机械贴标签。
cn.source_text: Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Division, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy — https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Division
questions: 整体指标是否掩盖了成员差异？
对这个具体对象有什么直接证据？
examples: 说明性示例：知识库总体评价不错，不表示每一条出处都已核实；逐条检查来源比借用整体信誉更可靠。
cn.article_body:
仅因整体具有某种性质，就断言每个组成部分或成员也必然具有该性质。

整体指标会掩盖分布和成员差异。平均交付速度、品牌信誉或总体正确率，都不能直接变成每个任务和成员的保证。应检查具体对象的数据以及指标的计算方式。

## 如何应用

1. 标出整体命题与个体结论。
2. 检查分布及指标定义。
3. 补充具体对象证据再作判断。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：知识库总体评价不错，不表示每一条出处都已核实；逐条检查来源比借用整体信誉更可靠。

## 使用边界

定义上适用于全部成员的性质可以下推，不能机械贴标签。

整体信息仍可提供背景，但通常不足以保证个体结果。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Division, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Division)

en.name: Fallacy of Division
en.description: The fallacy of division attributes a property of a whole to every part without sufficient justification.
trigger: Inferring individual traits from group traits
Arguments of the form 'the team is strong, so every member is strong'
avoid_when: Some properties legitimately apply to all members by definition.
Aggregate information can inform a judgment without guaranteeing an individual outcome.
transform: Separate the aggregate claim from the individual conclusion.
Check the metric and distribution.
Gather case-specific evidence.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Separate the aggregate claim from the individual conclusion. Check the metric and distribution. Gather case-specific evidence. Some properties legitimately apply to all members by definition.
en.source_text: Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Division, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy — https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Division
questions: Does the aggregate conceal variation?
What evidence concerns this particular case?
examples: Illustrative example: A well-regarded knowledge library can still contain individual entries with unverified sources.
en.article_body:
The fallacy of division attributes a property of a whole to every part without sufficient justification.

Aggregate metrics can conceal variation. Overall accuracy or reputation does not guarantee each item. Inspect the distribution and evidence about the particular case.

## Applying the idea

1. Separate the aggregate claim from the individual conclusion.
2. Check the metric and distribution.
3. Gather case-specific evidence.

## An example

Illustrative example: A well-regarded knowledge library can still contain individual entries with unverified sources.

## Limits

Some properties legitimately apply to all members by definition.

Aggregate information can inform a judgment without guaranteeing an individual outcome.

## Sources and further reading

- [Bradley Dowden — Fallacies: Division, Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy](https://iep.utm.edu/fallacy/#Division)

cn.name: 巴纳姆效应
cn.description: 人容易把模糊、普遍适用的人格描述当作对自己特别准确的刻画。
trigger: 评估星座、性格测试、算命等描述时
avoid_when: 通用建议也可能有用，不能仅因通用就判为错误。
不要依据一次认同诊断他人。
transform: 把描述改写成可观察行为。
比较符合与不符合的情境。
依据具体证据决定是否采用。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：把描述改写成可观察行为。 比较符合与不符合的情境。 依据具体证据决定是否采用。 通用建议也可能有用，不能仅因通用就判为错误。
cn.source_text: APA Dictionary — Barnum effect — https://dictionary.apa.org/barnum-effect
questions: 换个人也会觉得准确吗？
描述能排除哪些情境？
examples: 说明性示例：推荐写着“你想提高效率又担心失误”。改成“你通过增加并行任务缩短交付时间”，再核对用户是否确实这样做。
cn.article_body:
人容易把模糊、普遍适用的人格描述当作对自己特别准确的刻画。

主观贴合感不能证明解释具有区分能力。检查同一句话能否被不同的人认领，及其能否作出具体预测。将这个检查用在知识推荐上属于应用类比，不表示原研究验证了推荐产品。

## 如何应用

1. 把描述改写成可观察行为。
2. 比较符合与不符合的情境。
3. 依据具体证据决定是否采用。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：推荐写着“你想提高效率又担心失误”。改成“你通过增加并行任务缩短交付时间”，再核对用户是否确实这样做。

## 使用边界

通用建议也可能有用，不能仅因通用就判为错误。

不要依据一次认同诊断他人。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [APA Dictionary — Barnum effect](https://dictionary.apa.org/barnum-effect)

en.name: Barnum Effect
en.description: People can accept vague, broadly applicable personality descriptions as uniquely accurate accounts of themselves.
trigger: Evaluating horoscopes, personality tests, or fortune-telling statements
avoid_when: A general suggestion can still be useful or true.
Do not diagnose someone from one response.
transform: Translate the statement into observable behavior.
Compare matching and nonmatching situations.
Decide from specific evidence.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Translate the statement into observable behavior. Compare matching and nonmatching situations. Decide from specific evidence. A general suggestion can still be useful or true.
en.source_text: APA Dictionary — Barnum effect — https://dictionary.apa.org/barnum-effect
questions: Would a different person also accept this?
Which situations does it exclude?
examples: Illustrative example: Replace “You want efficiency but fear mistakes” with “You increase parallel work to shorten delivery time,” then check whether the condition actually holds.
en.article_body:
People can accept vague, broadly applicable personality descriptions as uniquely accurate accounts of themselves.

Personal resonance does not establish discrimination. Check whether different people can accept the same words and whether the description yields a specific prediction. Applying this check to software recommendations is an analogy, not a reported experimental finding.

## Applying the idea

1. Translate the statement into observable behavior.
2. Compare matching and nonmatching situations.
3. Decide from specific evidence.

## An example

Illustrative example: Replace “You want efficiency but fear mistakes” with “You increase parallel work to shorten delivery time,” then check whether the condition actually holds.

## Limits

A general suggestion can still be useful or true.

Do not diagnose someone from one response.

## Sources and further reading

- [APA Dictionary — Barnum effect](https://dictionary.apa.org/barnum-effect)

cn.name: 知识诅咒
cn.description: 知道某项信息后，难以完全排除它的影响，从而误判不知道该信息的人会如何理解或判断。
trigger: 设计教学、文档、产品说明
avoid_when: 沟通失败也可能由动机、界面或信息量造成。
简化不能删除决定适用性的技术条件。
transform: 列出读者已有知识与未知前提。
按具体任务补足术语与步骤。
让未参与编写的人试读并复述。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：列出读者已有知识与未知前提。 按具体任务补足术语与步骤。 让未参与编写的人试读并复述。 沟通失败也可能由动机、界面或信息量造成。
cn.source_text: Camerer, Loewenstein & Weber (1989), The Curse of Knowledge in Economic Settings — https://www.cmu.edu/dietrich/sds/docs/loewenstein/CurseknowledgeEconSet.pdf
questions: 哪些前提只有我知道？
读者能独立复述并完成第一步吗？
examples: 说明性示例：把“运行迁移”改写为包含入口、前置条件、成功标志的操作说明，再让首次使用者照做。
cn.article_body:
知道某项信息后，难以完全排除它的影响，从而误判不知道该信息的人会如何理解或判断。

原论文讨论更知情者模拟较少知情者判断的困难。写文档时，作者容易省略自己已熟悉的前提。解决方向是观察读者实际操作，而不只请作者想象读者是否懂了。

## 如何应用

1. 列出读者已有知识与未知前提。
2. 按具体任务补足术语与步骤。
3. 让未参与编写的人试读并复述。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：把“运行迁移”改写为包含入口、前置条件、成功标志的操作说明，再让首次使用者照做。

## 使用边界

沟通失败也可能由动机、界面或信息量造成。

简化不能删除决定适用性的技术条件。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Camerer, Loewenstein & Weber (1989), The Curse of Knowledge in Economic Settings](https://www.cmu.edu/dietrich/sds/docs/loewenstein/CurseknowledgeEconSet.pdf)

en.name: Curse of Knowledge
en.description: Knowing information can make it difficult to judge how someone without that information would understand or decide.
trigger: Designing teaching material, docs, or product instructions
avoid_when: Communication failures may also reflect motivation, interface, or overload.
Simplification must preserve conditions that matter.
transform: List the reader's knowledge and missing prerequisites.
Explain terms and task steps.
Ask a new reader to try and restate them.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: List the reader's knowledge and missing prerequisites. Explain terms and task steps. Ask a new reader to try and restate them. Communication failures may also reflect motivation, interface, or overload.
en.source_text: Camerer, Loewenstein & Weber (1989), The Curse of Knowledge in Economic Settings — https://www.cmu.edu/dietrich/sds/docs/loewenstein/CurseknowledgeEconSet.pdf
questions: Which premises are known only to me?
Can a reader independently explain and perform the first step?
examples: Illustrative example: Replace “run the migration” with prerequisites, the entry point, and observable success criteria, then have a novice follow it.
en.article_body:
Knowing information can make it difficult to judge how someone without that information would understand or decide.

The original research examined better-informed people predicting less-informed judgments. Documentation writers may similarly omit familiar prerequisites. Observe actual readers rather than relying only on the author's imagined novice perspective.

## Applying the idea

1. List the reader's knowledge and missing prerequisites.
2. Explain terms and task steps.
3. Ask a new reader to try and restate them.

## An example

Illustrative example: Replace “run the migration” with prerequisites, the entry point, and observable success criteria, then have a novice follow it.

## Limits

Communication failures may also reflect motivation, interface, or overload.

Simplification must preserve conditions that matter.

## Sources and further reading

- [Camerer, Loewenstein & Weber (1989), The Curse of Knowledge in Economic Settings](https://www.cmu.edu/dietrich/sds/docs/loewenstein/CurseknowledgeEconSet.pdf)

cn.name: 回音室效应
cn.description: 一种信息环境：内部声音被强化，外部来源的可信度被系统性削弱，使成员难以重新评价共同信念。
avoid_when: 专业共识不自动等于回音室。
更多链接未必提供独立来源；也不能要求无差别相信所有声音。
transform: 追踪论据的原始出处。
区分来源遗漏与预先否定外部可信度。
引入可检查的独立材料并讨论信任依据。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：追踪论据的原始出处。 区分来源遗漏与预先否定外部可信度。 引入可检查的独立材料并讨论信任依据。 专业共识不自动等于回音室。
cn.source_text: C. Thi Nguyen (2020), Echo Chambers and Epistemic Bubbles — https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/episteme/article/abs/echo-chambers-and-epistemic-bubbles/5D4AC3A808C538E17C50A7C09EC706F0
questions: 相同信息是否来自同一个源头？
反方被评价的是证据，还是身份？
examples: 说明性示例：十篇文章都转引同一未核实故事，整理者把它记为一个来源，再寻找独立研究。
cn.article_body:
一种信息环境：内部声音被强化，外部来源的可信度被系统性削弱，使成员难以重新评价共同信念。

Nguyen 区分未接触到不同声音的认知泡沫和主动排斥外部可信度的回音室。前者可能通过扩大接触改善，后者还涉及信任关系。不能只凭意见一致，就认定群体封闭或其观点错误。

## 如何应用

1. 追踪论据的原始出处。
2. 区分来源遗漏与预先否定外部可信度。
3. 引入可检查的独立材料并讨论信任依据。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：十篇文章都转引同一未核实故事，整理者把它记为一个来源，再寻找独立研究。

## 使用边界

专业共识不自动等于回音室。

更多链接未必提供独立来源；也不能要求无差别相信所有声音。

en.description: An echo chamber reinforces internal voices while systematically undermining the credibility of outside sources.
avoid_when: Expert consensus is not automatically an echo chamber.
More links do not necessarily mean independent evidence.
transform: Trace claims to their origins.
Distinguish omission from active discrediting.
Examine independent material and reasons for trust.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Trace claims to their origins. Distinguish omission from active discrediting. Examine independent material and reasons for trust. Expert consensus is not automatically an echo chamber.
en.source_text: C. Thi Nguyen (2020), Echo Chambers and Epistemic Bubbles — https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/episteme/article/abs/echo-chambers-and-epistemic-bubbles/5D4AC3A808C538E17C50A7C09EC706F0
questions: Do apparently separate reports share one origin?
Is an objection assessed by evidence or identity?
examples: Illustrative example: Ten articles copying one unverified story are recorded as one source before independent evidence is sought.
en.article_body:
An echo chamber reinforces internal voices while systematically undermining the credibility of outside sources.

Nguyen distinguishes missing outside voices in epistemic bubbles from active discrediting in echo chambers. Exposure alone may address omission but not distrust. Agreement by itself neither establishes closure nor shows that a belief is false.

## Applying the idea

1. Trace claims to their origins.
2. Distinguish omission from active discrediting.
3. Examine independent material and reasons for trust.

## An example

Illustrative example: Ten articles copying one unverified story are recorded as one source before independent evidence is sought.

## Limits

Expert consensus is not automatically an echo chamber.

More links do not necessarily mean independent evidence.

## Sources and further reading

- [C. Thi Nguyen (2020), Echo Chambers and Epistemic Bubbles](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/episteme/article/abs/echo-chambers-and-epistemic-bubbles/5D4AC3A808C538E17C50A7C09EC706F0)

cn.name: 基本归因错误
cn.description: 解释他人行为时，过度强调其稳定性格或态度，而低估当时的情境压力与约束。
trigger: 出现'他一定是故意的'式判断
avoid_when: 考虑情境不等于取消责任。
不能用这个标签替代对具体行为的证据，倾向也并非各情境同样强。
transform: 描述行为，暂缓人格标签。
查明信息、资源及制度条件。
比较不同情境并选择相应改进措施。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：描述行为，暂缓人格标签。 查明信息、资源及制度条件。 比较不同情境并选择相应改进措施。 考虑情境不等于取消责任。
cn.source_text: APA Dictionary — Fundamental attribution error — https://dictionary.apa.org/fundamental-attribution-error
questions: 哪些限制没有被观察到？
同一人在条件变化后是否仍这样做？
examples: 说明性示例：同事未按时交稿，先核对依赖材料和需求变化，再决定问题来自估算、流程还是履约。
cn.article_body:
解释他人行为时，过度强调其稳定性格或态度，而低估当时的情境压力与约束。

人更容易看到行为者，却未必看见资源、规则和激励。先分开行为事实与性格推断，再考察同一个人在不同情境中的表现，有助于产生可检验的解释。情境影响与个人责任可以同时存在。

## 如何应用

1. 描述行为，暂缓人格标签。
2. 查明信息、资源及制度条件。
3. 比较不同情境并选择相应改进措施。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：同事未按时交稿，先核对依赖材料和需求变化，再决定问题来自估算、流程还是履约。

## 使用边界

考虑情境不等于取消责任。

不能用这个标签替代对具体行为的证据，倾向也并非各情境同样强。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [APA Dictionary — Fundamental attribution error](https://dictionary.apa.org/fundamental-attribution-error)

en.name: Fundamental Attribution Error
en.description: People may overemphasize another person's enduring traits while underestimating situational constraints on behavior.
trigger: Explaining why someone acted a certain way
Judgments like 'he must have done it on purpose'
avoid_when: Considering context does not remove responsibility.
The tendency is not equally strong in every setting.
transform: Describe behavior without a personality label.
Investigate information, resources, and rules.
Compare situations and address the supported cause.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Describe behavior without a personality label. Investigate information, resources, and rules. Compare situations and address the supported cause. Considering context does not remove responsibility.
en.source_text: APA Dictionary — Fundamental attribution error — https://dictionary.apa.org/fundamental-attribution-error
questions: Which constraints were unobserved?
Does the behavior persist when conditions change?
examples: Illustrative example: Before calling a late contributor unreliable, check missing inputs and changed requirements.
en.article_body:
People may overemphasize another person's enduring traits while underestimating situational constraints on behavior.

Actions are visible while resources, rules, and incentives may be hidden. Separate observations from trait inferences and compare behavior across situations. Contextual influence and individual responsibility can coexist.

## Applying the idea

1. Describe behavior without a personality label.
2. Investigate information, resources, and rules.
3. Compare situations and address the supported cause.

## An example

Illustrative example: Before calling a late contributor unreliable, check missing inputs and changed requirements.

## Limits

Considering context does not remove responsibility.

The tendency is not equally strong in every setting.

## Sources and further reading

- [APA Dictionary — Fundamental attribution error](https://dictionary.apa.org/fundamental-attribution-error)

cn.name: 幸存者偏差
cn.description: 只观察留存、成功或可见的对象，忽略退出与失败对象，导致对原始总体的判断偏差。
trigger: 分析成功案例总结'成功学'
avoid_when: 无法观察缺失者时，应限定结论，不能编造其特征。
不是每份成功经验都错误，但不能由幸存者直接推出普遍成功率。
transform: 确定最初总体与可见样本。
追踪淘汰和记录缺失机制。
补充失败样本或明确结论边界。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：确定最初总体与可见样本。 追踪淘汰和记录缺失机制。 补充失败样本或明确结论边界。 无法观察缺失者时，应限定结论，不能编造其特征。
cn.source_text: Mangel & Samaniego (1984), Abraham Wald's Work on Aircraft Survivability — https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.1984.10478038
questions: 哪些对象没有机会留下记录？
存活条件是否与我要解释的结果有关？
examples: 说明性示例：只收藏成功项目复盘会让方法显得万能；同时记录使用同一方法却失败的情境，再审视适用条件。
cn.article_body:
只观察留存、成功或可见的对象，忽略退出与失败对象，导致对原始总体的判断偏差。

能被看到本身可能经过筛选。先还原进入样本的路径，再寻找消失对象和缺失原因。飞机案例的关键是数据来自幸存者，而非某张流传弹孔图的具体位置。

## 如何应用

1. 确定最初总体与可见样本。
2. 追踪淘汰和记录缺失机制。
3. 补充失败样本或明确结论边界。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：只收藏成功项目复盘会让方法显得万能；同时记录使用同一方法却失败的情境，再审视适用条件。

## 使用边界

无法观察缺失者时，应限定结论，不能编造其特征。

不是每份成功经验都错误，但不能由幸存者直接推出普遍成功率。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Mangel & Samaniego (1984), Abraham Wald's Work on Aircraft Survivability](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.1984.10478038)

en.name: Survivorship Bias
en.description: Observing only surviving, successful, or visible cases can distort conclusions about the original population.
trigger: When failure cases are missing from data
avoid_when: Do not invent the characteristics of unobserved cases.
Successful accounts can be useful without establishing general success rates.
transform: Identify the original population and visible sample.
Trace attrition and recording mechanisms.
Add missing cases or limit the conclusion.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Identify the original population and visible sample. Trace attrition and recording mechanisms. Add missing cases or limit the conclusion. Do not invent the characteristics of unobserved cases.
en.source_text: Mangel & Samaniego (1984), Abraham Wald's Work on Aircraft Survivability — https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.1984.10478038
questions: Who could not leave a record?
Is survival related to the outcome being explained?
examples: Illustrative example: Pair successful project retrospectives with cases where the same method failed before recommending it broadly.
en.article_body:
Observing only surviving, successful, or visible cases can distort conclusions about the original population.

Visibility may be the result of selection. Reconstruct entry into the sample and investigate missing cases. The aircraft example concerns inference from survivors, not the details of a popular bullet-hole illustration.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify the original population and visible sample.
2. Trace attrition and recording mechanisms.
3. Add missing cases or limit the conclusion.

## An example

Illustrative example: Pair successful project retrospectives with cases where the same method failed before recommending it broadly.

## Limits

Do not invent the characteristics of unobserved cases.

Successful accounts can be useful without establishing general success rates.

## Sources and further reading

- [Mangel & Samaniego (1984), Abraham Wald's Work on Aircraft Survivability](https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/01621459.1984.10478038)

cn.name: 冗余与备份
cn.description: 冗余通过额外组件或路径降低单点故障影响；备份保留可恢复的数据副本，两者解决的问题相关但不同。
trigger: 设计不能单点失效的系统
avoid_when: 冗余不能保证避免共同原因故障。
备份有维护与访问控制成本，应按数据价值和恢复需求设计。
transform: 列出单点与共同故障路径。
设计隔离副本及保留周期。
在独立环境恢复并验证内容和资产。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：列出单点与共同故障路径。 设计隔离副本及保留周期。 在独立环境恢复并验证内容和资产。 冗余不能保证避免共同原因故障。
cn.source_text: CISA — #StopRansomware Guide — https://www.cisa.gov/stopransomware/ransomware-guide
questions: 多个副本会不会同时受到同一故障影响？
最近一次恢复测试验证了什么？
examples: 说明性示例：写入知识前创建SQLite快照，再从快照读取条目与图片引用，证明可恢复，而不仅是磁盘上多一个文件。
cn.article_body:
冗余通过额外组件或路径降低单点故障影响；备份保留可恢复的数据副本，两者解决的问题相关但不同。

同步副本也会同步误删，多个副本还可能共享电源、权限或灾害风险。需要明确要恢复到哪个时间点、多久恢复，并通过实际演练验证。知识库场景中，副本存在不等于能正确恢复内容与资产。

## 如何应用

1. 列出单点与共同故障路径。
2. 设计隔离副本及保留周期。
3. 在独立环境恢复并验证内容和资产。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：写入知识前创建SQLite快照，再从快照读取条目与图片引用，证明可恢复，而不仅是磁盘上多一个文件。

## 使用边界

冗余不能保证避免共同原因故障。

备份有维护与访问控制成本，应按数据价值和恢复需求设计。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [CISA — #StopRansomware Guide](https://www.cisa.gov/stopransomware/ransomware-guide)

en.name: Redundancy and backups
en.description: Redundancy adds components or paths to reduce single-point failures; backups retain recoverable data states. These are related but distinct protections.
trigger: Designing systems that must not have a single point of failure
avoid_when: Redundancy does not eliminate common-cause failures.
Backup design must balance maintenance, access control, and recovery needs.
transform: Identify single points and shared failure paths.
Design isolated copies and retention.
Restore separately and verify data and assets.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Identify single points and shared failure paths. Design isolated copies and retention. Restore separately and verify data and assets. Redundancy does not eliminate common-cause failures.
en.source_text: CISA — #StopRansomware Guide — https://www.cisa.gov/stopransomware/ransomware-guide
questions: Can one failure affect every copy?
What did the last recovery test verify?
examples: Illustrative example: Before a knowledge import, create a SQLite snapshot and read its records and asset references to confirm recoverability.
en.article_body:
Redundancy adds components or paths to reduce single-point failures; backups retain recoverable data states. These are related but distinct protections.

Synchronized replicas can propagate deletion, and copies may share power, permissions, or disaster exposure. Define acceptable recovery points and recovery time, then test restoration. A file's existence does not prove that content and assets can be recovered.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify single points and shared failure paths.
2. Design isolated copies and retention.
3. Restore separately and verify data and assets.

## An example

Illustrative example: Before a knowledge import, create a SQLite snapshot and read its records and asset references to confirm recoverability.

## Limits

Redundancy does not eliminate common-cause failures.

Backup design must balance maintenance, access control, and recovery needs.

## Sources and further reading

- [CISA — #StopRansomware Guide](https://www.cisa.gov/stopransomware/ransomware-guide)

cn.name: 奥卡姆剃刀
cn.description: 在解释力、证据适配等条件相当时，优先考虑引入更少不必要假设或实体的解释。
trigger: 存在多个 competing 解释
理论变得越来越复杂时
avoid_when: 不能以简单为由删除已知关键机制。
简洁有不同度量，必须说明比较口径。
transform: 列出待解释事实和候选解释。
检查各自所需假设与遗漏。
在证据适配相当时选择更节约的方案，并继续检验。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：列出待解释事实和候选解释。 检查各自所需假设与遗漏。 在证据适配相当时选择更节约的方案，并继续检验。 不能以简单为由删除已知关键机制。
cn.source_text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Simplicity — https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/simplicity/
questions: 两个解释覆盖的是同一组事实吗？
哪些假设只是为了保住解释而追加？
examples: 说明性示例：搜索结果为空时，先检验查询条件与语言筛选，再考虑复杂的存储损坏假说；若简单原因不符就继续调查。
cn.article_body:
在解释力、证据适配等条件相当时，优先考虑引入更少不必要假设或实体的解释。

简洁可以指基本假设较少，也可以指实体种类较少，两者未必一致。先比较能否解释关键观察，再比较复杂度。它是一条选择与检查原则，不能代替实验或保证最简单说法正确。

## 如何应用

1. 列出待解释事实和候选解释。
2. 检查各自所需假设与遗漏。
3. 在证据适配相当时选择更节约的方案，并继续检验。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：搜索结果为空时，先检验查询条件与语言筛选，再考虑复杂的存储损坏假说；若简单原因不符就继续调查。

## 使用边界

不能以简单为由删除已知关键机制。

简洁有不同度量，必须说明比较口径。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Simplicity](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/simplicity/)

en.name: Occam's Razor
en.description: Other things being equal, prefer explanations with fewer unnecessary assumptions or kinds of entities.
trigger: A theory growing ever more complex
avoid_when: Do not delete known mechanisms for apparent simplicity.
Specify the sense in which an explanation is simpler.
transform: List observations and candidate explanations.
Check assumptions and omissions.
Prefer economy when evidence fit is comparable, then test.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: List observations and candidate explanations. Check assumptions and omissions. Prefer economy when evidence fit is comparable, then test. Do not delete known mechanisms for apparent simplicity.
en.source_text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Simplicity — https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/simplicity/
questions: Do the explanations cover the same observations?
Which assumptions were added only to rescue the explanation?
examples: Illustrative example: For empty search results, examine filters and locale before assuming database corruption, while remaining ready to investigate further.
en.article_body:
Other things being equal, prefer explanations with fewer unnecessary assumptions or kinds of entities.

Syntactic simplicity and ontological parsimony are different. Compare coverage of the relevant observations before comparing complexity. The razor guides selection and investigation; it neither replaces tests nor guarantees truth.

## Applying the idea

1. List observations and candidate explanations.
2. Check assumptions and omissions.
3. Prefer economy when evidence fit is comparable, then test.

## An example

Illustrative example: For empty search results, examine filters and locale before assuming database corruption, while remaining ready to investigate further.

## Limits

Do not delete known mechanisms for apparent simplicity.

Specify the sense in which an explanation is simpler.

## Sources and further reading

- [Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Simplicity](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/simplicity/)

cn.name: 汉隆剃刀
cn.description: 当疏忽、误解或能力限制已经能解释一件事时，先不要直接认定它出于恶意。
trigger: 被冒犯、被阻碍时的第一反应
avoid_when: 有恶意或持续伤害证据时不能继续拿格言否认。
不必把替代解释称为愚蠢，可具体讨论信息和流程限制。
transform: 分开事实、影响与动机推测。
检查遗漏、误解和流程原因。
根据证据回应，同时保护必要边界。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：分开事实、影响与动机推测。 检查遗漏、误解和流程原因。 根据证据回应，同时保护必要边界。 有恶意或持续伤害证据时不能继续拿格言否认。
cn.source_text: The Jargon File — Hanlon's Razor — https://www.catb.org/jargon/html/H/Hanlons-Razor.html
questions: 有什么非恶意解释与事实相符？
是否有明确证据支持蓄意行为？
examples: 说明性示例：协作者没处理请求，先核对消息送达与职责归属；若多次明确拒绝且造成损害，再依据行为处理。
cn.article_body:
当疏忽、误解或能力限制已经能解释一件事时，先不要直接认定它出于恶意。

它让调查保留较少敌意的解释，适合信息不足时降低不必要的冲突。判断仍需看事实：错误是否可重复、是否得到纠正，以及是否存在明确的伤害证据。善意假设不能代替保护措施。

## 如何应用

1. 分开事实、影响与动机推测。
2. 检查遗漏、误解和流程原因。
3. 根据证据回应，同时保护必要边界。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：协作者没处理请求，先核对消息送达与职责归属；若多次明确拒绝且造成损害，再依据行为处理。

## 使用边界

有恶意或持续伤害证据时不能继续拿格言否认。

不必把替代解释称为愚蠢，可具体讨论信息和流程限制。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [The Jargon File — Hanlon's Razor](https://www.catb.org/jargon/html/H/Hanlons-Razor.html)

en.name: Hanlon's Razor
en.description: When oversight, misunderstanding, or limited capability adequately explains an event, do not immediately assume malice.
trigger: First reaction to being offended or blocked
avoid_when: Do not ignore evidence of malice or persistent harm.
Describe specific information or process failures rather than insulting intelligence.
transform: Separate facts, impacts, and inferred motives.
Check omissions and misunderstandings.
Respond to evidence while maintaining boundaries.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Separate facts, impacts, and inferred motives. Check omissions and misunderstandings. Respond to evidence while maintaining boundaries. Do not ignore evidence of malice or persistent harm.
en.source_text: The Jargon File — Hanlon's Razor — https://www.catb.org/jargon/html/H/Hanlons-Razor.html
questions: Which nonmalicious explanations fit the facts?
Is there direct evidence of deliberate harm?
examples: Illustrative example: For an unanswered request, first check delivery and ownership before inferring hostile intent.
en.article_body:
When oversight, misunderstanding, or limited capability adequately explains an event, do not immediately assume malice.

The heuristic keeps less hostile explanations available under uncertainty. Examine repeated behavior, responses to correction, and evidence of deliberate harm. A charitable hypothesis does not replace protective action.

## Applying the idea

1. Separate facts, impacts, and inferred motives.
2. Check omissions and misunderstandings.
3. Respond to evidence while maintaining boundaries.

## An example

Illustrative example: For an unanswered request, first check delivery and ownership before inferring hostile intent.

## Limits

Do not ignore evidence of malice or persistent harm.

Describe specific information or process failures rather than insulting intelligence.

## Sources and further reading

- [The Jargon File — Hanlon's Razor](https://www.catb.org/jargon/html/H/Hanlons-Razor.html)

cn.name: 希钦斯剃刀
cn.description: 对没有提供支持证据的事实断言，可以暂不接受；反对者不必先为每个无根据断言完成全面反证。
trigger: 面对没有证据支持的断言
宗教、阴谋论等不可验证主张
avoid_when: 没有证据不等于已有反证。
个人偏好、探索性假设与已被支持的事实断言不能一概处理。
transform: 明确被要求接受的主张。
要求与主张匹配的依据。
证据不足时暂缓接受并写出重新评价的条件。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：明确被要求接受的主张。 要求与主张匹配的依据。 证据不足时暂缓接受并写出重新评价的条件。 没有证据不等于已有反证。
cn.source_text:
Christopher Hitchens (2007), God Is Not Great — publisher record — https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/christopher-hitchens/god-is-not-great/9780446195348/
Christopher Hitchens (2003), On secularism & religion, Dædalus — https://www.amacad.org/sites/default/files/daedalus/downloads/Daedalus_Su03_On-Secularism-and-Religion.pdf
questions: 这是事实断言、价值偏好还是假设？
对方提供了哪些可检查的支持？
examples: 说明性示例：有人称某工具适合所有团队，却只提供口号；评审把该说法记为未证实，并要求说明测试对象、任务与结果。
cn.article_body:
对没有提供支持证据的事实断言，可以暂不接受；反对者不必先为每个无根据断言完成全面反证。

这条论证格言提醒提出主张的人承担相应支持责任。拒绝接受与证明为假是不同判断。资料不足时，可以明确标成待证，并说明怎样的证据会让讨论继续，而不是用格言终止一切沟通。

## 如何应用

1. 明确被要求接受的主张。
2. 要求与主张匹配的依据。
3. 证据不足时暂缓接受并写出重新评价的条件。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：有人称某工具适合所有团队，却只提供口号；评审把该说法记为未证实，并要求说明测试对象、任务与结果。

## 使用边界

没有证据不等于已有反证。

个人偏好、探索性假设与已被支持的事实断言不能一概处理。

en.name: Hitchens's Razor
en.description: An unsupported factual assertion need not be accepted simply because nobody has produced an exhaustive refutation.
trigger: Unverifiable claims like religion or conspiracy theories
avoid_when: Absence of evidence is not automatically disproof.
Preferences and exploratory hypotheses require different treatment from factual claims.
transform: Identify the assertion being advanced.
Request relevant support.
Withhold acceptance if needed and state revision conditions.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Identify the assertion being advanced. Request relevant support. Withhold acceptance if needed and state revision conditions. Absence of evidence is not automatically disproof.
en.source_text:
Christopher Hitchens (2007), God Is Not Great — publisher record — https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/christopher-hitchens/god-is-not-great/9780446195348/
Christopher Hitchens (2003), On secularism & religion, Dædalus — https://www.amacad.org/sites/default/files/daedalus/downloads/Daedalus_Su03_On-Secularism-and-Religion.pdf
questions: Is this a factual claim, a preference, or a hypothesis?
What checkable support has been offered?
examples: Illustrative example: A claim that a tool suits every team is marked unestablished until its tasks, participants, and observed outcomes are described.
en.article_body:
An unsupported factual assertion need not be accepted simply because nobody has produced an exhaustive refutation.

The maxim associated with Hitchens assigns a supporting burden to the person making a claim. Withholding acceptance differs from proving falsehood. Mark an unsupported claim as unestablished and state what evidence would reopen assessment.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify the assertion being advanced.
2. Request relevant support.
3. Withhold acceptance if needed and state revision conditions.

## An example

Illustrative example: A claim that a tool suits every team is marked unestablished until its tasks, participants, and observed outcomes are described.

## Limits

Absence of evidence is not automatically disproof.

Preferences and exploratory hypotheses require different treatment from factual claims.

cn.name: 萨根标准
cn.description: 当一个事实主张与已有可靠知识或通常预期差距很大时，需要更有力、可检查的证据支持。

证据强度与主张强度不匹配时

transform: 明确主张与已有基线的差异。
检查常见替代解释及数据质量。
寻找独立验证并相应更新判断。

cn.article_body:
当一个事实主张与已有可靠知识或通常预期差距很大时，需要更有力、可检查的证据支持。

“惊人”应落实为与哪些已知事实冲突，而不是由个人好恶决定。检验可从测量错误、选择性报告和替代解释入手，再看独立验证能否支持主张。保持开放也包括愿意因好证据修正旧观点。

## 如何应用

1. 明确主张与已有基线的差异。
2. 检查常见替代解释及数据质量。
3. 寻找独立验证并相应更新判断。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：一个工具宣称让所有任务快十倍；先检查任务范围、比较基线与失败案例，再要求独立复现，而不是只看演示。

不能因为结论陌生就拒绝查看证据。

证据要求应说明理由，不应无限提高到任何发现都无法满足。

en.name: Sagan's Standard
en.description: A claim that sharply conflicts with established knowledge or ordinary expectations requires correspondingly strong, checkable support.
trigger: Evaluating astonishing claims (aliens, miracles, miracle products)
When evidence strength mismatches claim strength
avoid_when: Unfamiliar conclusions should not be rejected without examination.
Evidence requirements need reasons and must remain achievable.
transform: State the disagreement with the baseline.
Check alternatives and data quality.
Seek independent corroboration and update.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: State the disagreement with the baseline. Check alternatives and data quality. Seek independent corroboration and update. Unfamiliar conclusions should not be rejected without examination.
en.source_text:
Carl Sagan (1987), The Burden of Skepticism — https://skepticalinquirer.org/1987/10/the-burden-of-skepticism/
Committee for Skeptical Inquiry — What is Skepticism? — https://skepticalinquirer.org/what-is-skepticism/
questions: Which reliable baseline does the claim challenge?
What evidence distinguishes discovery from error?
examples: Illustrative example: A tenfold productivity claim is assessed against task scope, baselines, failure cases, and independent replication rather than a demonstration alone.
en.article_body:
A claim that sharply conflicts with established knowledge or ordinary expectations requires correspondingly strong, checkable support.

Specify which reliable baseline the claim challenges. Examine measurement errors, selective reporting, and alternative explanations before evaluating independent confirmation. Skepticism also requires readiness to revise established beliefs when evidence warrants it.

## Applying the idea

1. State the disagreement with the baseline.
2. Check alternatives and data quality.
3. Seek independent corroboration and update.

## An example

Illustrative example: A tenfold productivity claim is assessed against task scope, baselines, failure cases, and independent replication rather than a demonstration alone.

## Limits

Unfamiliar conclusions should not be rejected without examination.

Evidence requirements need reasons and must remain achievable.

## Sources and further reading

cn.description: 收集和评价证据时偏向支持已有期待的材料，忽略或弱化相反信息。

观点不同不能证明一方有偏误。

统一评价来源、方法和相关性。

cn.article_body:
收集和评价证据时偏向支持已有期待的材料，忽略或弱化相反信息。

偏差可进入搜索词、样本选择和结果解释。事先写清什么观察会改变结论，再对两类材料使用相同标准，能让检查过程更明确。证据质量无需为了形式平衡而被抹平。

## 如何应用

1. 在搜索前写下假设及推翻条件。
2. 检查不支持假设的样本。
3. 统一评价来源、方法和相关性。

不必为形式平衡保留低质量反对意见。

观点不同不能证明一方有偏误。

en.description: Evidence gathering or evaluation may favor prior expectations while neglecting contradictory information.
trigger: Having a conclusion before finding evidence
Filtering information to support your side
avoid_when: Do not manufacture balance with weak objections.
Disagreement alone does not establish bias.
transform: State the hypothesis and revision conditions.
Inspect unsupported or contrary cases.
Assess source quality and relevance consistently.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: State the hypothesis and revision conditions. Inspect unsupported or contrary cases. Assess source quality and relevance consistently. Do not manufacture balance with weak objections.
en.source_text: APA Dictionary — Confirmation bias — https://dictionary.apa.org/confirmation-bias

Were the same quality standards applied?

en.article_body:
Evidence gathering or evaluation may favor prior expectations while neglecting contradictory information.

Bias can enter through queries, sampling, and interpretation. Specify revision conditions before collecting evidence and apply equal standards to supporting and opposing material. Equal standards do not require equal weight for evidence of unequal quality.

## Applying the idea

1. State the hypothesis and revision conditions.
2. Inspect unsupported or contrary cases.
3. Assess source quality and relevance consistently.

## An example

Illustrative example: Evaluate recommendations using positive feedback together with empty and irrelevant results.

## Limits

Do not manufacture balance with weak objections.

Disagreement alone does not establish bias.

## Sources and further reading

- [APA Dictionary — Confirmation bias](https://dictionary.apa.org/confirmation-bias)

cn.name: 循证实践
cn.description: 结合当前可靠研究证据、实践经验和相关者的需求与价值作出决定，并在实施后检查效果。

cn.article_body:
结合当前可靠研究证据、实践经验和相关者的需求与价值作出决定，并在实施后检查效果。

它的医学背景强调将证据用于具体个体，而非机械执行论文结论。用于知识管理时，可把问题界定、资料评价、适用性判断和结果复核连成循环。研究质量高不意味着与当前任务一定相关。

## 如何应用

1. 提出可以回答的具体问题。
2. 评价来源质量与情境适用性。
3. 结合经验及需求实施，并记录结果以便修正。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：选择一种整理方法前，先看其证据适用对象，再小范围试用，记录维护成本与重新找到知识的实际情况。

## 使用边界

不能把单篇论文或研究数量当成最终权威。

en.name: Evidence-Based Practice
en.description: Evidence-based practice combines reliable research, practical expertise, and stakeholders' needs and values, then evaluates outcomes.
trigger: Making professional decisions amid information overload
avoid_when: One paper or a large citation count is not final authority.
When evidence is limited, state assumptions and review points rather than claiming certainty.
transform: Formulate an answerable question.
Appraise quality and applicability.
Combine expertise and needs, apply, and review outcomes.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Formulate an answerable question. Appraise quality and applicability. Combine expertise and needs, apply, and review outcomes. One paper or a large citation count is not final authority.

BMJ Best Practice — What is EBM? — https://bestpractice.bmj.com/info/us/evidence/learn-ebm/what-is-ebm/

How do participants, conditions, and outcomes differ?
examples: Illustrative example: Trial an organizing method after checking its context, then record maintenance effort and successful rediscovery.
en.article_body:
Evidence-based practice combines reliable research, practical expertise, and stakeholders' needs and values, then evaluates outcomes.

Its medical background emphasizes applying evidence to an individual situation rather than mechanically obeying a paper. In knowledge work, question formulation, appraisal, application, and review form a useful cycle. Strong research can still be poorly matched to the present task.

## Applying the idea

1. Formulate an answerable question.
2. Appraise quality and applicability.
3. Combine expertise and needs, apply, and review outcomes.

## An example

Illustrative example: Trial an organizing method after checking its context, then record maintenance effort and successful rediscovery.

## Limits

One paper or a large citation count is not final authority.

When evidence is limited, state assumptions and review points rather than claiming certainty.

cn.article_body:
选择一个方案所放弃的最佳可行替代方案的价值，就是该选择的机会成本。

成本不仅包括付款，还包括被占用时间和其他资源的用途。比较时要使用同一资源约束和评价尺度，并把“暂不做”作为可能选项。多个互斥替代方案的价值不能全部相加。

## 如何应用

1. 明确稀缺资源与时间窗口。
2. 列出可行替代项并比较价值。
3. 把最佳放弃项纳入决策记录。

Opportunity cost is the value of the best feasible alternative forgone when choosing an option.

Payment is only part of cost; time and resources have alternative uses. Compare options under the same constraints, including doing nothing for now. Do not add together the values of mutually exclusive alternatives.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify scarce resources and the time window.
2. Compare feasible alternatives.
3. Record the best alternative sacrificed.

## An example

## Limits

Nonmonetary value need not be forced into spurious prices.

Express uncertain benefits as ranges or conditions.

已经发生、无法收回且不随当前选择改变的成本，不应单独成为继续投入的理由。

examples: Illustrative example: Having curated a hundred entries does not settle how to curate the next hundred; assess maintenance value and preserve useful work while changing the method.
en.article_body:
Irrecoverable past costs that do not change across current options should not, by themselves, justify further investment.

Compare consequences from now onward. Past work can leave useful assets, learning, or obligations that affect future outcomes. Ignoring sunk costs can still lead to continuing a project.

## Applying the idea

1. Separate irrecoverable past costs from future consequences.
2. Compare continuing, reducing, pausing, and exiting.
3. Decide from incremental future value.

## An example

Illustrative example: Having curated a hundred entries does not settle how to curate the next hundred; assess maintenance value and preserve useful work while changing the method.

## Limits

Recoverable assets and future cancellation costs remain relevant.

Do not diagnose motives merely because someone persists.

cn.article_body:
用分支表示可控选择、不可控事件及其结果的决策分析工具，帮助比较多阶段方案。

先区分自己能选择的节点与由外部情况决定的节点。若有可靠概率和可比价值，可以从末端向前计算期望结果；若资料不足，也可以只用树澄清条件和待查问题。画得完整不等于输入可信。

## 如何应用

1. 标出顺序、选择与外部事件。
2. 列出终点结果及证据支持的参数。
3. 比较方案并测试关键假设变化。

What supports the probabilities and outcome values?
examples: Illustrative example: Compare a single migration with staged migration through validation, rollback, and rework branches.
en.article_body:
A decision-analysis tree represents choices, uncertain events, and outcomes to compare sequential options.

Distinguish controllable decisions from chance events. When probabilities and comparable values are supported, work backward to evaluate expected outcomes. Without them, a tree can still clarify dependencies and research questions.

## Applying the idea

1. Map sequence, decisions, and uncertain events.
2. Specify outcomes and supported parameters.
3. Compare options and vary sensitive assumptions.

## An example

Illustrative example: Compare a single migration with staged migration through validation, rollback, and rework branches.

## Limits

Do not invent numbers to make the tree look precise.

Expected value alone omits some preferences, catastrophic risks, and irreversible constraints.

cn.article_body:
用容易想起的例子估计频率或概率时，记忆显著性可能使判断偏离实际发生情况。

容易想到不是事件的分母。近期经历和醒目报道值得核查，却不足以决定概率。记录最初估计，再找同一人群和时间范围的基线，才能判断印象是否需要调整。

## 如何应用

1. 记录当前判断与想到的案例。

Without baseline data, retain uncertainty.

Find comparable baseline data.

en.agent_instruction: To apply: Record the judgment and salient examples. Find comparable baseline data. Revise within the data's coverage. Experience can be informative in stable environments.
en.source_text: APA Dictionary — Availability heuristic — https://dictionary.apa.org/availability-heuristic
questions: Am I recalling frequency or a vivid case?
What is the denominator and time interval?
examples: Illustrative example: After a public data-loss incident, a team reviews its own failures and recovery exercises before redesigning storage.
en.article_body:
Estimating frequency or probability from readily recalled examples can mislead when memory salience differs from occurrence.

Memorability is not a denominator. Recent experiences and vivid reports warrant investigation, but do not establish probability. Compare an initial impression with baseline data for a defined population and period.

## Applying the idea

1. Record the judgment and salient examples.
2. Find comparable baseline data.
3. Revise within the data's coverage.

## An example

Illustrative example: After a public data-loss incident, a team reviews its own failures and recovery exercises before redesigning storage.

## Limits

Experience can be informative in stable environments.

Without baseline data, retain uncertainty.

## Sources and further reading

- [APA Dictionary — Availability heuristic](https://dictionary.apa.org/availability-heuristic)

按信息、感受、风险、价值、创意和过程管理六种思考功能组织讨论，让参与者在同一时段聚焦同一类问题。

白帽看信息，红帽表达感受，黑帽检查风险，黄帽探索价值，绿帽生成想法，蓝帽管理过程。可以按任务选择顺序，成员共同切换视角。它是讨论组织方法，不能替代事实调查或专业决策。

1. 用蓝帽明确问题、时间和产出。

White addresses information, red feelings, black risks, yellow benefits, green ideas, and blue the process. Participants switch modes together as useful for the task. The method structures discussion rather than establishing factual truth.

回答者可能为了符合社会规范或获得认可而给出体面的答案，使自报偏离真实看法或行为。

提问者的期待和评价关系可能影响回答。中性提问、具体经历和适当隐私保护可以减少表态压力。自报与行动不一致也可能来自资源约束，不能只用客套解释。

样本选择系统性偏向某些对象，使样本模式不能直接代表目标总体。

questions: Is confidence based on evidence or familiarity?
Do multiple citations trace to one original?
examples: Illustrative example: Several blogs repeat one efficiency maxim from an essay; the library labels it an aphorism rather than a law supported by multiple studies.
en.article_body:
Repeated exposure can increase a statement's perceived truth even when repetition adds no independent evidence.

The original experiments examined repetition and validity ratings. Distinguish familiarity from independent replication: several reposts are not separate tests. The effect concerns judgment, not a rule that repeated statements are false.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify original sources.
2. Collapse reposts and check independence.
3. State confidence based on evidence.

## An example

Illustrative example: Several blogs repeat one efficiency maxim from an essay; the library labels it an aphorism rather than a law supported by multiple studies.

## Limits

Repeated accurate information remains potentially accurate.

A single judgment does not reveal the size of an individual's bias.

## Sources and further reading

- [Hasher, Goldstein & Toppino (1977), Frequency and the Conference of Referential Validity](https://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/brenner/mar7588/Papers/hasher-et-al-jvvb-1977.pdf)

cn.name: 错误共识效应
cn.description: 高估他人与自己意见、信念或行为一致的程度，误把个人立场当作普遍立场。
trigger: 把自己的观点当成'常识'
avoid_when: 意见一致可能真实存在。
少数反例不能确定总体比例。
transform: 标记源于个人经验的判断。
收集不同使用者的独立描述。
区分共识、分歧与未知。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：标记源于个人经验的判断。 收集不同使用者的独立描述。 区分共识、分歧与未知。 意见一致可能真实存在。
cn.source_text: APA Dictionary — False-consensus effect — https://dictionary.apa.org/false-consensus-effect
questions: 是否把个人偏好写成用户普遍需要？
有哪些不同背景的直接反馈？
examples: 说明性示例：维护者习惯英文缩写，访谈发现新手只会描述现象，于是补录自然语言触发场景。
cn.article_body:
高估他人与自己意见、信念或行为一致的程度，误把个人立场当作普遍立场。

熟悉的同伴可能形成局部共识。把“我会这样做”改成待调查假设，独立询问不同背景的人，才能发现默认需求。真正存在的共识也需要写明人群范围。

## 如何应用

1. 标记源于个人经验的判断。
2. 收集不同使用者的独立描述。
3. 区分共识、分歧与未知。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：维护者习惯英文缩写，访谈发现新手只会描述现象，于是补录自然语言触发场景。

## 使用边界

意见一致可能真实存在。

少数反例不能确定总体比例。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [APA Dictionary — False-consensus effect](https://dictionary.apa.org/false-consensus-effect)

en.name: False Consensus Effect
en.description: People can overestimate how widely others share their own opinions, beliefs, or behavior.
trigger: Consensus judgment inside a small circle
avoid_when: Agreement can be genuine.
A few exceptions do not establish a population rate.
transform: Identify assumptions based on personal experience.
Gather independent descriptions.
Separate agreement, disagreement, and unknown groups.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Identify assumptions based on personal experience. Gather independent descriptions. Separate agreement, disagreement, and unknown groups. Agreement can be genuine.
en.source_text: APA Dictionary — False-consensus effect — https://dictionary.apa.org/false-consensus-effect
questions: Did personal preference become a claim about all users?
What direct feedback comes from different backgrounds?
examples: Illustrative example: A maintainer expects English abbreviations, but novice interviews motivate adding natural-language search cues.
en.article_body:
People can overestimate how widely others share their own opinions, beliefs, or behavior.

Familiar peers may create a local consensus. Treat personal preferences as hypotheses and collect independent accounts across backgrounds. Even genuine agreement needs a stated population.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify assumptions based on personal experience.
2. Gather independent descriptions.
3. Separate agreement, disagreement, and unknown groups.

## An example

Illustrative example: A maintainer expects English abbreviations, but novice interviews motivate adding natural-language search cues.

## Limits

Agreement can be genuine.

A few exceptions do not establish a population rate.

## Sources and further reading

- [APA Dictionary — False-consensus effect](https://dictionary.apa.org/false-consensus-effect)

cn.name: 分析瘫痪
cn.description: 一个日常描述：反复搜集资料和比较选项，却无法推进决策，新增分析的价值已不清楚。
avoid_when: 高风险、不可逆决定确实需要充分调查。
该词不是对心理健康问题的诊断。
transform: 明确决策标准和最关键未知项。
设定调查结束或重新评估的条件。
选择可逆试验，或说明有理由的等待。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：明确决策标准和最关键未知项。 设定调查结束或重新评估的条件。 选择可逆试验，或说明有理由的等待。 高风险、不可逆决定确实需要充分调查。
cn.source_text: Christopher J. Anderson (2003), The psychology of doing nothing — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12555797/
questions: 新增信息会改变哪个选择？
继续分析的成本与可能价值是什么？
examples: 说明性示例：反复比较标签方案时，先用少量实际检索任务试两种方案，观察差异后决定，避免继续增加无关选项。
cn.article_body:
一个日常描述：反复搜集资料和比较选项，却无法推进决策，新增分析的价值已不清楚。

拖延可能涉及冲突、预期后悔或缺少停止规则，但不能从拖延本身断定原因。先找出真正会改变选择的未知项，再决定继续调查还是做可逆试验。等待重要信息也可能是合理决定。

## 如何应用

1. 明确决策标准和最关键未知项。
2. 设定调查结束或重新评估的条件。
3. 选择可逆试验，或说明有理由的等待。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：反复比较标签方案时，先用少量实际检索任务试两种方案，观察差异后决定，避免继续增加无关选项。

## 使用边界

高风险、不可逆决定确实需要充分调查。

该词不是对心理健康问题的诊断。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Christopher J. Anderson (2003), The psychology of doing nothing](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12555797/)

en.name: Analysis Paralysis
en.description: Analysis paralysis is an everyday description of repeated research and comparison that fails to advance a decision.
avoid_when: High-stakes irreversible choices may need extensive investigation.
This label is not a clinical diagnosis.
transform: Specify criteria and the decisive unknown.
Set investigation or review conditions.
Run a reversible trial or justify waiting.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Specify criteria and the decisive unknown. Set investigation or review conditions. Run a reversible trial or justify waiting. High-stakes irreversible choices may need extensive investigation.
en.source_text: Christopher J. Anderson (2003), The psychology of doing nothing — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12555797/
questions: Which choice could additional information change?
What are the cost and value of more analysis?
examples: Illustrative example: Try two tagging approaches on actual retrieval tasks instead of endlessly adding hypothetical alternatives.
en.article_body:
Analysis paralysis is an everyday description of repeated research and comparison that fails to advance a decision.

Delay can involve conflict, anticipated regret, or missing stopping rules, but the cause must be investigated. Identify information that could change the choice and compare further research with a reversible trial. Waiting for important information can be rational.

## Applying the idea

1. Specify criteria and the decisive unknown.
2. Set investigation or review conditions.
3. Run a reversible trial or justify waiting.

## An example

Illustrative example: Try two tagging approaches on actual retrieval tasks instead of endlessly adding hypothetical alternatives.

## Limits

High-stakes irreversible choices may need extensive investigation.

This label is not a clinical diagnosis.

## Sources and further reading

- [Christopher J. Anderson (2003), The psychology of doing nothing](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12555797/)

cn.name: 频率错觉
cn.description: 刚开始注意某种现象后，感觉它突然到处出现；这种感觉可能来自注意变化，而不只是实际频率变化。
trigger: 刚买车后觉得满街都是同款
刚学新概念后到处看见它
avoid_when: 真实频率也可能同步上升，不能直接否认变化。
标签相似不代表机制相同。
transform: 明确现象的识别标准。
比较相同时间和范围内的记录。
分别保留真实变化与注意变化两种解释。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：明确现象的识别标准。 比较相同时间和范围内的记录。 分别保留真实变化与注意变化两种解释。 真实频率也可能同步上升，不能直接否认变化。
cn.source_text:
Arnold Zwicky (2005), More illusions, Language Log — https://itre.cis.upenn.edu/~myl/languagelog/archives/002407.html
Arnold Zwicky — Illusions postings — https://arnoldzwicky.org/linguistics-notes/illusions-postings/
questions: 变化的是发生频率还是我的注意？
前后是否用了同样观察方式？
examples: 说明性示例：刚学到确认偏误就觉得每场讨论都有它；先记录具体的证据筛选行为，而不是凭印象给所有分歧贴标签。
cn.article_body:
刚开始注意某种现象后，感觉它突然到处出现；这种感觉可能来自注意变化，而不只是实际频率变化。

学会一个概念也改变了识别线索。仅凭“最近常见”不能区分现象增加和发现能力提升。记录同等观察窗口、明确识别标准，再比较频率，才能避免把新概念套到所有问题上。

## 如何应用

1. 明确现象的识别标准。
2. 比较相同时间和范围内的记录。
3. 分别保留真实变化与注意变化两种解释。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：刚学到确认偏误就觉得每场讨论都有它；先记录具体的证据筛选行为，而不是凭印象给所有分歧贴标签。

## 使用边界

真实频率也可能同步上升，不能直接否认变化。

标签相似不代表机制相同。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Arnold Zwicky (2005), More illusions, Language Log](https://itre.cis.upenn.edu/~myl/languagelog/archives/002407.html)
- [Arnold Zwicky — Illusions postings](https://arnoldzwicky.org/linguistics-notes/illusions-postings/)

en.name: Frequency Illusion
en.description: After noticing a phenomenon, it may suddenly seem ubiquitous because attention has changed, rather than solely because its frequency has increased.
trigger: Seeing your new car model everywhere
Noticing a new concept all around
avoid_when: Actual frequency may also rise.
Similar labels need not imply the same mechanism.
transform: Define observable criteria.
Compare records from similar periods and contexts.
Consider both real change and changed attention.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Define observable criteria. Compare records from similar periods and contexts. Consider both real change and changed attention. Actual frequency may also rise.
en.source_text:
Arnold Zwicky (2005), More illusions, Language Log — https://itre.cis.upenn.edu/~myl/languagelog/archives/002407.html
Arnold Zwicky — Illusions postings — https://arnoldzwicky.org/linguistics-notes/illusions-postings/
questions: Did occurrence or attention change?
Were the observation methods comparable?
examples: Illustrative example: After learning confirmation bias, record concrete evidence-selection behavior instead of labeling every disagreement with the new term.
en.article_body:
After noticing a phenomenon, it may suddenly seem ubiquitous because attention has changed, rather than solely because its frequency has increased.

Learning a concept changes recognition cues. A recent sense of prevalence cannot distinguish increased occurrence from increased detection. Use consistent observation windows and criteria before generalizing.

## Applying the idea

1. Define observable criteria.
2. Compare records from similar periods and contexts.
3. Consider both real change and changed attention.

## An example

Illustrative example: After learning confirmation bias, record concrete evidence-selection behavior instead of labeling every disagreement with the new term.

## Limits

Actual frequency may also rise.

Similar labels need not imply the same mechanism.

## Sources and further reading

- [Arnold Zwicky (2005), More illusions, Language Log](https://itre.cis.upenn.edu/~myl/languagelog/archives/002407.html)
- [Arnold Zwicky — Illusions postings](https://arnoldzwicky.org/linguistics-notes/illusions-postings/)

cn.name: 规划谬误
cn.description: 估计任务完成时间时，过度依赖理想执行计划，低估延误，并未充分利用相似任务的实际经验。
avoid_when: 历史任务不可比时不能机械照搬均值。
并非每次超期都来自认知偏差，范围变化也会影响结果。
transform: 收集相似任务的实际完成记录。
比较范围、依赖和资源差异。
给出有条件的区间并随新信息更新。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：收集相似任务的实际完成记录。 比较范围、依赖和资源差异。 给出有条件的区间并随新信息更新。 历史任务不可比时不能机械照搬均值。
cn.source_text: Buehler, Griffin & Ross (1994), Exploring the Planning Fallacy — https://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/brenner/mar7588/Papers/buehler-et-al-1994.pdf
questions: 相似任务实际用了多久？
过去经常出现的延误被放到哪里了？
examples: 说明性示例：估计补齐40条知识时，计入查不到原文、术语冲突与审校返工，而不只计算初稿撰写时间。
cn.article_body:
估计任务完成时间时，过度依赖理想执行计划，低估延误，并未充分利用相似任务的实际经验。

计划描述事情应该怎样发生，历史数据则包含中断、返工和依赖。先找可比任务的实际时长，再根据当前差异调整，比只逐步相加工序更能暴露遗漏。估计仍需说明范围和条件。

## 如何应用

1. 收集相似任务的实际完成记录。
2. 比较范围、依赖和资源差异。
3. 给出有条件的区间并随新信息更新。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：估计补齐40条知识时，计入查不到原文、术语冲突与审校返工，而不只计算初稿撰写时间。

## 使用边界

历史任务不可比时不能机械照搬均值。

并非每次超期都来自认知偏差，范围变化也会影响结果。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Buehler, Griffin & Ross (1994), Exploring the Planning Fallacy](https://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/brenner/mar7588/Papers/buehler-et-al-1994.pdf)

en.name: Planning Fallacy
en.description: Completion estimates can overrely on ideal plans while underusing relevant experience and underestimating delays.
avoid_when: Noncomparable histories should not be averaged mechanically.
Scope changes can also explain missed estimates.
transform: Collect actual durations for comparable tasks.
Assess differences in scope and dependencies.
Give a conditional range and update it.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: Collect actual durations for comparable tasks. Assess differences in scope and dependencies. Give a conditional range and update it. Noncomparable histories should not be averaged mechanically.
en.source_text: Buehler, Griffin & Ross (1994), Exploring the Planning Fallacy — https://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/brenner/mar7588/Papers/buehler-et-al-1994.pdf
questions: How long did comparable tasks actually take?
Where are recurring delays represented?
examples: Illustrative example: Estimating forty curated entries includes inaccessible sources and terminology review, not just drafting time.
en.article_body:
Completion estimates can overrely on ideal plans while underusing relevant experience and underestimating delays.

Plans describe intended execution; historical records include interruptions, rework, and dependencies. Start with comparable actual durations, then adjust for current differences. State a range and the conditions behind it.

## Applying the idea

1. Collect actual durations for comparable tasks.
2. Assess differences in scope and dependencies.
3. Give a conditional range and update it.

## An example

Illustrative example: Estimating forty curated entries includes inaccessible sources and terminology review, not just drafting time.

## Limits

Noncomparable histories should not be averaged mechanically.

Scope changes can also explain missed estimates.

## Sources and further reading

- [Buehler, Griffin & Ross (1994), Exploring the Planning Fallacy](https://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/brenner/mar7588/Papers/buehler-et-al-1994.pdf)

cn.name: 零风险偏差
cn.description: 过度偏好把某一项风险完全消除，即使同样资源用于其他方案能减少更多总体损失。
trigger: 出现'彻底消除风险'的选项时
avoid_when: 法律义务和不可承受的损失不能只用平均收益抵消。
风险概率不明时不能编造精确的最优比较。
transform: 列出相关风险、严重性与资源约束。
明确不能被权衡掉的底线。
比较剩余方案的总体风险降低与代价。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：列出相关风险、严重性与资源约束。 明确不能被权衡掉的底线。 比较剩余方案的总体风险降低与代价。 法律义务和不可承受的损失不能只用平均收益抵消。
cn.source_text: Baron, Gowda & Kunreuther (1993), Attitudes Toward Managing Hazardous Waste — https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1539-6924.1993.tb01068.x
questions: 清除这一项风险放弃了哪些更大的风险降低？
是否存在必须满足的安全底线？
examples: 说明性示例：为消除一个小的排版错误耗尽审校时间，却忽略出处错误；先定义内容准确性底线，再分配检查精力。
cn.article_body:
过度偏好把某一项风险完全消除，即使同样资源用于其他方案能减少更多总体损失。

“清零”容易形成心理上的完成感，但需要比较的是各方案对全部相关风险的影响。先区分不可接受的底线与可权衡的小风险，再比较同一资源投入的结果。零风险也可能是合理约束。

## 如何应用

1. 列出相关风险、严重性与资源约束。
2. 明确不能被权衡掉的底线。
3. 比较剩余方案的总体风险降低与代价。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：为消除一个小的排版错误耗尽审校时间，却忽略出处错误；先定义内容准确性底线，再分配检查精力。

## 使用边界

法律义务和不可承受的损失不能只用平均收益抵消。

风险概率不明时不能编造精确的最优比较。

## 出处与延伸阅读

- [Baron, Gowda & Kunreuther (1993), Attitudes Toward Managing Hazardous Waste](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1539-6924.1993.tb01068.x)

en.name: Zero-Risk Bias
en.description: Zero-risk bias is an excessive preference for eliminating one risk when the same resources could reduce more overall harm elsewhere.
trigger: When an 'eliminate risk entirely' option appears
avoid_when: Legal duties and intolerable losses cannot simply be offset by average benefits.
Do not fabricate probabilities for an apparently precise optimum.
transform: List risks, severity, and resource constraints.
Set nonnegotiable limits.
Compare overall reductions and costs.
en.agent_instruction: To apply: List risks, severity, and resource constraints. Set nonnegotiable limits. Compare overall reductions and costs. Legal duties and intolerable losses cannot simply be offset by average benefits.
en.source_text: Baron, Gowda & Kunreuther (1993), Attitudes Toward Managing Hazardous Waste — https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1539-6924.1993.tb01068.x
questions: What larger risk reductions are forgone?
Which safety requirements are nonnegotiable?
examples: Illustrative example: Do not consume all review time eliminating minor formatting errors while leaving source accuracy unchecked.
en.article_body:
Zero-risk bias is an excessive preference for eliminating one risk when the same resources could reduce more overall harm elsewhere.

Complete elimination can feel conclusive. Compare effects across relevant risks, first separating unacceptable outcomes from tradeable small risks. A zero-risk requirement can itself be justified by the context.

## Applying the idea

1. List risks, severity, and resource constraints.
2. Set nonnegotiable limits.
3. Compare overall reductions and costs.

## An example

Illustrative example: Do not consume all review time eliminating minor formatting errors while leaving source accuracy unchecked.

## Limits

Legal duties and intolerable losses cannot simply be offset by average benefits.

Do not fabricate probabilities for an apparently precise optimum.

## Sources and further reading

- [Baron, Gowda & Kunreuther (1993), Attitudes Toward Managing Hazardous Waste](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/j.1539-6924.1993.tb01068.x)

cn.name: 笛卡尔方法
cn.description: 对判断保持审慎，把复杂问题拆分，按由简到繁的次序推进，并通过完整复查减少遗漏。
trigger: 面对复杂难题无从下手
需要验证一个流行说法
avoid_when: 不应把主观清楚明白当作现代经验主张的充分证据。
时间有限时按重要性检查，避免无限怀疑。
transform: 明确问题和待检验的前提。
拆成可处理部分并按依赖顺序求解。
重组结果，复查遗漏和相互作用。
cn.agent_instruction: 应用时：明确问题和待检验的前提。 拆成可处理部分并按依赖顺序求解。 重组结果，复查遗漏和相互作用。 不应把主观清楚明白当作现代经验主张的充分证据。
cn.source_text: René Descartes (1637), Discourse on the Method, Part II — https://www.gutenberg.org/files/25830/25830-h/25830-h.htm
questions: 哪些前提被未经检验地接受？
拆分是否遗漏了部分之间的联系？
examples: 说明性示例：导入知识前分别检查ID、双语字段、来源和重复项，再在数据库副本中验证整条流程。
cn.article_body:
对判断保持审慎，把复杂问题拆分，按由简到繁的次序推进，并通过完整复查减少遗漏。

这一整理来自《谈谈方法》第二部分的四条规则。在实际任务中，拆分后还需检查部件之间的关系；分别正确不保证整体正确。清楚理解前提也不等于这些前提已经得到经验支持。

## 如何应用

1. 明确问题和待检验的前提。
2. 拆成可处理部分并按依赖顺序求解。

This practical summary draws on Part II of Discourse on the Method. After decomposition, examine interactions: correct components do not guarantee a correct whole. Clear understanding of a premise is not the same as empirical support.

Prioritize important checks rather than pursuing endless doubt.

帕金森对行政工作的经验性观察：当工作边界可伸缩时，它可能扩张到填满可用时间。

没有完成标准，额外时间可能用于追加讨论和打磨，而非增加必要价值。实践上可以事先约定交付物和停止条件，再用时间盒检查进度。这并不意味着任何工作都能在任意短期限内做好。

Without a completion standard, extra time may invite additional discussion or polishing. Define the deliverable and stopping conditions, then review progress within a realistic timebox. The observation does not make arbitrarily short deadlines feasible.

Exploration, learning, and safety checks genuinely require time.

Shorter deadlines do not replace scope reduction or resources.

cn.article_body:
关于估时的自指格言：任务常比预期更久，即使已经为这种低估留过余量。

它提醒人们保留对估计误差的警觉，不提供一个自动正确的缓冲比例。复杂依赖、新发现和返工都可能改变进度。应用时应持续观察实际推进速度，修改范围或日期，而不是不断叠加任意余量。

## 如何应用

1. 写明估算假设与未知项。
2. 用近期实际推进情况复核。
3. 在偏差出现时调整计划并说明原因。

## 一个例子

这是一条格言，不是所有任务都会延期的统计定律。

en.description: Hofstadter's law is a self-referential adage warning that tasks can take longer than expected even after allowing for underestimation.
avoid_when: An adage is not a statistical law that every task runs late.
It does not excuse skipping estimates or communication.

Compare estimates with actual progress.
Update plans when discrepancies appear.

questions: What supports the buffer?
Which discoveries could change remaining effort?
examples: Illustrative example: When inaccessible papers increase review time, revise the estimate from completed entries rather than defending the original date.
en.article_body:
Hofstadter's law is a self-referential adage warning that tasks can take longer than expected even after allowing for underestimation.

It encourages humility about estimates rather than prescribing a correct buffer percentage. Dependencies, discoveries, and rework can change remaining effort. Review observed progress and adjust scope or timing instead of repeatedly adding arbitrary slack.

## Applying the idea

1. Document assumptions and unknowns.
2. Compare estimates with actual progress.
3. Update plans when discrepancies appear.

## An example

Illustrative example: When inaccessible papers increase review time, revise the estimate from completed entries rather than defending the original date.

## Limits

An adage is not a statistical law that every task runs late.

It does not excuse skipping estimates or communication.

2. 估计培训、交接和协调成本。

en.article_body:
Adding people to a late, tightly coordinated software project can delay it further through training, communication, and partitioning costs.

Newcomers need context and existing members spend time onboarding them. A serial critical path does not shrink automatically with headcount. Compare onboarding costs with useful contribution over the remaining period.

## Applying the idea

1. Identify the critical path and parallel work.
2. Estimate onboarding and coordination.
3. Choose staffing, scope, or schedule changes from net contribution.

## An example

Illustrative example: Near an import deadline, assign independent source checking rather than having several people edit the same database script.

## Limits

Independent work and longer horizons can benefit from more people.

Skills, tools, and module boundaries matter.

设计组织的沟通结构会约束和塑造它所形成的系统结构。

当两个模块需要紧密协作，对应人员就需要足够的协调渠道。部门边界、职责和激励会影响哪些设计容易落地。检查架构时可以同时画出模块依赖与沟通关系，但不能仅凭组织图预测全部实现。

An organization's communication structure constrains and shapes the structure of the systems it designs.

Closely interacting modules require coordination among their designers. Ownership boundaries and incentives affect feasible designs. Compare module dependencies with communication paths, without assuming the organization chart predicts every implementation detail.

2. Compare ownership and communication paths.
3. Address coordination gaps and observe the result.

cn.article_body:
当API使用者足够多时，某些人可能依赖系统各种可观察行为，即使这些行为不在正式契约中。

返回顺序、错误文本和时间特征都可能被使用者视作稳定条件。兼容性检查因此需要了解实际消费方式。这个观察提示设计迁移与弃用流程，并不要求永久冻结所有偶然行为。

en.article_body:
With enough API users, someone may depend on observable behavior that was never promised in the formal contract.

Ordering, error messages, and timing can become practical dependencies. Compatibility work therefore needs evidence about real consumers. The observation motivates migration and deprecation planning, not permanent preservation of every accident.

2. Inspect consumers, tests, and feedback.
3. Clarify contracts and validate a migration.

Small unpublished interfaces may have a different dependency surface.

Theoretical observability does not prove an existing dependency.

cn.description: 当代理指标承受强烈优化或控制压力时，它与真正目标之间的关系可能变弱，甚至导致行为损害原目标。

当代理指标承受强烈优化或控制压力时，它与真正目标之间的关系可能变弱，甚至导致行为损害原目标。

指标通常只覆盖目标的一部分。人可以改善被计数的部分，却忽略未计数的质量；过度优化也可能利用噪声或改变原有条件。需要检查实际结果，而不是只判断数字是否上升。

## 如何应用

1. 写清真实目标与代理指标的关系。
2. 找出可钻空子和遗漏的质量维度。
3. 结合实际案例复查指标并修订激励。

这不意味着测量无用或每次设目标都会失败。

增加更多指标也可能增加负担，需要明确每项用途。

en.name: Goodhart's Law
en.description: Strong optimization of a proxy metric can weaken its connection to the real objective and sometimes harm that objective.
avoid_when: Measurement is not inherently useless.
More metrics can also add cost and confusion.
transform: State the goal-to-metric relationship.
Identify gaming opportunities and omitted quality.
Review real cases and revise incentives.

Marilyn Strathern (1997), Improving ratings: audit in the British University system — https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/european-review/article/abs/improving-ratings-audit-in-the-british-university-system/FC2EE640C0C44E3DB87C29FB666E9AAB
questions: Can the score improve while experience worsens?
Which important outcomes are unmeasured?
examples: Illustrative example: Entry-count targets can reward shallow imports, so also examine whether users find, understand, and appropriately apply the content.
en.article_body:
Strong optimization of a proxy metric can weaken its connection to the real objective and sometimes harm that objective.

Metrics capture only part of a goal. Counted aspects can improve while omitted quality declines; overoptimization can also exploit noise or shift conditions. Inspect actual outcomes instead of relying only on a rising number.

## Applying the idea

1. State the goal-to-metric relationship.
2. Identify gaming opportunities and omitted quality.
3. Review real cases and revise incentives.

## An example

Illustrative example: Entry-count targets can reward shallow imports, so also examine whether users find, understand, and appropriately apply the content.

## Limits

Measurement is not inherently useless.

More metrics can also add cost and confusion.

从不希望发生的结果或失败方式出发，倒推需要避免或检验的条件，再用于改进正向方案。

从成功愿望出发容易遗漏失败路径。反向提问能增加候选风险，但这些风险仍需证据与优先级判断。避免若干失败条件也不保证达到目标，还需检查正向价值。

## 如何应用

1. 明确目标和不可接受结果。
2. 列出导致失败的具体条件。
3. 把关键条件转成预防或检测措施，再复核正向价值。

en.article_body:
Start from an unwanted outcome or failure mode, reason backward to its conditions, and use those conditions to improve the forward plan.

Success-focused planning can overlook failure paths. Inversion generates risks to examine; it does not prove their likelihood. Avoiding failure is also insufficient without checking that the proposal creates value.

## Applying the idea

1. Define the goal and unacceptable outcomes.
2. List concrete failure conditions.
3. Turn important conditions into prevention or detection, then check value.

## An example

Illustrative example: Duplicate identities, lost articles, and partial writes motivate deduplication, preservation, atomic publication, and recovery tests.

## Limits

Imagined risks need causal and consequence checks.

Avoiding failure does not guarantee adequate benefit.

在直接结果之后继续问“然后会怎样”，检查后续反应、激励变化和较长时间范围内的影响。

把因果链画短而具体，标出每一步依赖的假设和可能时滞，再检查可观察证据。Howard Marks 的“第二层思维”着重比较投资判断与市场共识，和二阶后果推演有交集，但不是同一个定义。

## 如何应用

1. 列出直接后果与受影响对象。
2. 推演少量关键后续反应并标注条件。
3. 检查证据、时滞与可监测信号。

cn.article_body:
面对习惯性做法时，明确最基本且有依据的事实、约束和目标，从这些前提出发重新构造方案。

在哲学中，第一原理与论证的基本出发点有关；现代问题解决借用这个名称强调拆开事实与惯例。任务中的基本事实仍可能需要实测，不能把个人确信当成不可怀疑的真理。类比和已有经验也可以提供有价值的线索。

## 如何应用

1. 写出目标和不可忽略的约束。
2. 把事实、假设与习惯分开。
3. 构造替代方案并用实际条件检验。

Separate supported facts, constraints, and goals from customary solutions, then reconstruct an approach from those premises.

Philosophical first principles concern starting points of demonstration. Modern problem solving borrows the idea to question inherited assumptions. Practical premises still need evidence; personal certainty is not proof, and analogy remains a useful source of ideas.

Engineering and scheduling uses are analogies that require their own definitions of capacity, time, or loss tolerance. Buffers absorb only some errors and cannot rescue fundamentally wrong premises. Explain what a buffer protects and why it is adequate.

examples: 说明性示例：评审自己的知识卡与外部卡片时隐藏作者，按准确性、可读性和检索用途评价，再决定保留或改写。
cn.article_body:
拥有某物之后，对放弃它要求的补偿可能高于未拥有时愿意为获得它支付的代价。

研究中通过愿意接受与愿意支付的差异考察这种现象。在项目中，可以用中立标准重新评价自己已写的代码或条目，但差异也可能来自真实熟悉成本、用途和情感价值。不能只凭舍不得就判定不理性。

## 如何应用

1. 分别估计获得价值与放弃代价。
2. 分离真实转换成本和所有权偏爱。
3. 用相同标准比较现有与替代方案。

## 一个例子

说明性示例：评审自己的知识卡与外部卡片时隐藏作者，按准确性、可读性和检索用途评价，再决定保留或改写。

## 使用边界

两种报价不同不自动证明存在偏差。

个人纪念意义和实际用途可以构成合理价值。

## 出处与延伸阅读

en.article_body:
Ownership can be associated with requiring more compensation to give something up than one would pay to acquire it.

Experiments examine differences between willingness to accept and willingness to pay. In projects, neutral criteria can help reassess owned work, while switching costs, use value, and personal meaning remain relevant. Reluctance alone does not establish irrationality.

## Applying the idea

1. Estimate acquisition value and relinquishment cost.
2. Identify genuine costs and ownership preference.
3. Compare existing and alternative options using common criteria.

## An example

Illustrative example: Review internal and external knowledge cards without author labels using accuracy, readability, and retrieval usefulness.

## Limits

Different valuations alone do not prove bias.

Personal meaning and practical usefulness can justify value.

note.cn: 分别检查高估他人认同与高估他人已有知识。

note.cn: 在分支结果中计入放弃的最佳可行用途，保持比较条件一致。

note.cn: 决策树帮助组织选择，但过度增加分支也会阻碍推进。
note.en: Trees can organize choices; excessive branching can also obstruct a decision.

note.cn: 讨论模式和收口条件可帮助将无序争论转成明确下一步。

note.cn: 前者是估时偏差研究，后者是提醒估计局限的格言，证据性质不同。

note.cn: 用历史记录检查估算，再为明确的不确定性设置余量。

note.cn: 人员与沟通结构共同影响软件工作，分别检查增员成本和架构边界。

note.cn: 延期后的加人计划也需计入培训、交接和重新估算。
note.en: Late staffing plans need onboarding, handoff, and revised estimates.

note.cn: 改变可观察行为前，推演使用者依赖和迁移后的影响。

note.cn: 用实际结果复查指标优化是否仍服务原目标。

note.cn: 指标激励可能改变后续行为，需检查短期数字之外的结果。

note.cn: 分别检查失败路径与后续连锁反应，显式记录假设。

note.cn: 合理余量针对明确风险；清零偏好可能忽视更有效的资源用途。
note.en: Justified buffers address specified uncertainty; zero-risk preference can neglect better uses of resources.
